The strategy says Security Precautions is the third starting Effect (should 'prolly be No Escape'); no single starting Effect is named, so starting effect is left empty.
Total is 58 as published (Characters posted as 23 but the lines add to 24; 1+6+4+24+1+3+12+7).

Posted 'Presence' x2 dested Presence Of The Force (Dark Effect); 'The Emp' dested The Emperor; 'IG w/ riot gun' IG-88 With Riot Gun; 'Imp City' Coruscant: Imperial City; 'Coruscant' the Dark Special Edition printing.
